objective: A: mk2 geometry with current mk1 palette; B: mk1 identity/palette with mk2 hard-surface facets. B helmet revision: broad integrated crown, lowered brow, V amber visor and compact chin module based on user-uploaded close-up.

runtime.implementation: Original Thunder mesh and UV base retained; fitted low crown and authored cheek/chin/side geometry on the original skeleton. Amber visor is selected and brightened in painted_armor.gdshader; material ID 9 remains reserved rather than being the main faceplate.
runtime.limitations: First-pass 3D adaptation, not an exact complete reconstruction. The source low-poly silhouette remains visible; continuous curved shell, ear recesses and fine seams are simplified relative to the approved concept.
runtime.unchanged: Equipment IDs, gameplay stats, save format, other armor sets and original source assets.
